params.body:
Two small things that showed on the live site.

## Placeholder copy

The fallback texts for missing content spoke about the owner in the third person ("wordt binnenkort ingevuld door de uitbater"), which reads as a note to the builder rather than something a visitor should see. They now say it plainly:

- Kaart: "De kaart wordt binnenkort toegevoegd."
- Contact: "Telefoon en e-mail worden binnenkort toegevoegd."
- Home and Over: "Het verhaal volgt binnenkort." (Over lede: "Het langere verhaal volgt binnenkort.")

## Favicon

The facade line drawing read as a thick blur at tab size. It is replaced by a single capital H in Cormorant Garamond SemiBold, the wordmark typeface, cream on oxblood with rounded corners. The letter is outlined to a path, so it renders the same without the font. Variants with "'t H" were tried and dropped: the 't is unreadable at 16 px.

## Checked

- Rendered at 16, 32, 64 and 128 px in headless Chromium.
- No build run: only an SVG and fallback strings changed.
params.title: Plain placeholder copy and an initial as favicon
